title: Naive retriever returns from the entire corpus, including scraped content

evidence.excerpt: def retrieve(self, query: str) -> Retrieval: return Retrieval(self.index.top(query, self.top_k), entities=[])

fix: Restrict retrieval to authorized sources or per-entity/document scopes, and exclude sensitive or scraped chunks from default retrieval paths.

title: User-controlled query is concatenated into the same message as retrieved context, enabling instruction hijacking
fix: Place retrieved context and the user question in separate messages, and explicitly delimit/quote the question as data. Add server-side filtering to strip or reject instruction-like content from retrieved chunks and user input before prompting.

title: Entity-aware retrieval still falls back to arbitrary official chunks when entity resolution fails or yields no match

evidence.excerpt: def retrieve(self, query: str) -> Retrieval: entities = self.kb.detect_entities(query) if not entities: return Retrieval(self.index.top(query, self.top_k, self.official), entities=[]) # Every mentioned entity gets its own share of context, so one fund's wording can't crowd out another. per_entity =

fix: Require explicit entity authorization and hard-fail when no entity is resolved, rather than broad fallback retrieval; constrain retrieval to a validated entity-to-doc mapping before exposing context to the model.

title: Retrieved document text is sent to the model verbatim, exposing any embedded secrets or hidden instructions
fix: Redact secrets and instruction-like content from chunks before inclusion, and only pass minimal excerpts necessary to answer the query. Consider using a retrieval layer that sanitizes documents and removes sensitive fields prior to prompt assembly.

title: Retriever surfaces arbitrary scraped chunks from the full corpus without any provenance or instruction filtering

evidence.excerpt: scored = [ (self.score(terms, i), -i, chunk) for i, chunk in enumerate(self.chunks) if allowed is None or chunk.chunk_id in allowed ] scored.sort(key=lambda s: (s[0], s[1]), reverse=True) return [chunk for score, _, chunk in scored[:k] if score > 0]

fix: Add provenance-based filtering and prompt-injection sanitization before returning retrieved text; do not include untrusted scraped chunks unless they are explicitly isolated and labeled, and apply a relevance/instruction filter to reject chunks containing prompt-like directives.

title: Claims not supported by retrieved context (1/41 cases)

evidence.excerpt: Q: Should I switch from Horizon Debt Fund to Momentum Equity Fund? | A: I can’t recommend whether to switch funds or which would be better for you, but here are the available facts: Asterion Horizon Debt Fund is a “Medium to Long Duration Fund” with a **Moderate** riskome | The factual fund descriptions and risk disclosures are supported by the official factsheets, but the recommendation to consult a SEBI-registered investment advisor is unsupported by the retrieved context.

fix: Ground answers in retrieved official text only.

title: No per-user rate limit declared
fix: Declare and enforce a per-user/session rate limit (HTTP 429).

title: Untrusted `run_id` is passed into the LLM client without any validation or length cap

evidence.excerpt: response = client.chat(messages, purpose="bot", run_id=run_id, offline_key=offline_key(version, case.id))

fix: Validate and bound `run_id` before passing it to downstream clients (for example, enforce a short allowed character set and maximum length), and reject or truncate oversized values.

title: Model not pinned to a snapshot
fix: Pin a dated model snapshot so behaviour doesn't change under you.
